_comment: EGM Downloader Windows update feed. Upload to egerena.com/apps/egm-version.json
_version_notes: Cookies browse now uses native file dialog instead of browser file picker — fixes cookies browse on Linux and improves reliability on all platforms
Cookies section condensed to single always-visible row with extension tooltips — no more expand/collapse needed
Download folder section condensed — removed redundant "Files saved to" line
Check for Updates button moved to Update Plugins header — auto-expands panel when clicked
Advanced panel: added descriptive tooltips to all action buttons (Desktop shortcut, Clear cache, Export/Import settings, Reinstall ffmpeg/Deno, Reset settings)
Version tooltip removed from header badge — cleaner look

Dead code cleanup: removed legacy password-protected zip support (APP_UPDATE_PASSWORD, pyzipper dependency) from all platforms — codebase now reflects v0.98 unencrypted distribution model with SHA256 verification

notes: Cookies browse now uses native file dialog instead of browser file picker — fixes cookies browse on Linux and improves reliability on all platforms
Cookies section condensed to single always-visible row with extension tooltips — no more expand/collapse needed
Download folder section condensed — removed redundant "Files saved to" line
Check for Updates button moved to Update Plugins header — auto-expands panel when clicked
Advanced panel: added descriptive tooltips to all action buttons (Desktop shortcut, Clear cache, Export/Import settings, Reinstall ffmpeg/Deno, Reset settings)
Version tooltip removed from header badge — cleaner look

Dead code cleanup: removed legacy password-protected zip support (APP_UPDATE_PASSWORD, pyzipper dependency) from all platforms — codebase now reflects v0.98 unencrypted distribution model with SHA256 verification
Open folder from expanded download history panel now works correctly (history window was missing API bridge that prevented folder actions)
Video thumbnail aspect ratio corrected — widescreen (16:9) videos now display at proper proportions instead of appearing stretched vertically
Version references corrected — footer version pill and What's New header now update correctly during version bumps (scripts coverage gap fixed)
Portable: Update Plugins pane now accessible in portable mode with safety disclaimer for plugin recovery

Electron runtime upgraded to v41.5.0 (security and compatibility improvements; v29 line is end-of-life with no security backports — this upgrade incorporates accumulated Chromium security fixes and backported CVEs from the Electron security advisory line)
electron-builder updated to v26.8.1 (build toolchain compatibility with Electron 41)
Open folder from the expanded download history panel does not work — use the hamburger menu's open folder action instead. Fix planned for next release.
URL input pane redesigned — compact unified buttons (28px), textarea shrinks to 3 lines by default and auto-grows as URLs are added, "Max videos" caption replaces "Videos"
Drag and drop URLs directly into the URL textarea — visual drag-over feedback, filters comment lines, appends cleanly
Keyboard shortcuts — paste-and-fetch (Ctrl+V / ⌘V), clear textarea (Esc), trigger Fetch Info (Ctrl+Enter / ⌘Return)
All Themes window redesigned — categories moved to left sidebar with collapsible sections (Style, Vibe, Culture, Other); search bar compact (expands on focus); category counts shown
Download subtitles toggle in Advanced panel — embeds English subtitles (manual preferred, auto-generated fallback) directly into video file; no separate .srt files
Embed metadata toggle in Advanced panel (ON by default) — embeds thumbnail, chapter markers, and title/artist/date metadata into downloaded videos
Output format selector in Advanced panel — switch between MP4 (default) and MKV container for video downloads
Video quality picker expanded — 8K (4320p), 4K (2160p), and 2K (1440p) added with High Resolution / Standard tier separators
Audio quality picker expanded — M4A (256 kbps) and OPUS (128 kbps, 192 kbps) formats added alongside MP3 and FLAC with format section dividers
Checksum verification for auto-updates — SHA256 computed during build, embedded in JSON feed, verified before extracting installer; tampering detected and blocked
Distribution zips are now unencrypted — EGMd.zip and EGMdM.zip are standard zips; pyzipper dependency removed; SHA256 replaces password as integrity mechanism
What's New modal now reads release notes live from the JSON feed — no more hardcoded bullets; shows "Loading…" while fetching, graceful fallback if offline

14 new themes (120 total: 110 permanent + 10 seasonal) — Destiny characters (Cayde-6, Zavala, Savathûn, The Witness), Hyrule, Velvet Rose, Nocturnix, Hanami, Sugar Riot, Sundrop, Dream Dust, First Light, Neon Kiss, Prism
6 Mood themes added — Melancholy, Euphoria, Tension, Serenity, Nostalgia, Focus
Theme CSS is now a single shared source — main app and themes window both include theme_styles.html; new themes apply everywhere automatically
Theme validation switched from static allowlist to regex — future themes work without code changes
Mac auto-update now opens the download page in the browser — no more confusing error on non-installer builds
Double update toast guard added — auto-check on launch no longer fires twice
Security hardening — URL scheme validation on all API endpoints, IPC input allowlists, concurrent_fragments clamped 1–16, video_height allowlisted, open-folder path safety
App size reduced ~40MB — Python bundle stripped of pip, setuptools, idlelib, tkinter, pycache on Mac and Linux builds
Desktop shortcut button shows confirmation dialog; detects if shortcut already exists and shows "already exists" toast instead of overwriting
Reinstall ffmpeg and Reinstall Deno now have distinct icons (▶ and ⬡) for quick visual identification
Advanced panel section labels removed — cleaner layout for power users; buttons are self-explanatory
Footer spacing tightened between Advanced panel and footer

Windows portable edition — EGMd-portable.zip runs from any folder or USB stick; no installer, no registry, no system changes; settings and history stay in data/ inside the portable folder; auto-update disabled
Portable variant has its own update feed (egm-portable-version.json) and update UI is hidden automatically when running portable
Build pipeline now produces both installer and portable zips in one pass
Mac auto-update — now opens download page in browser instead of attempting installer launch; no false error
Footer spacing — gap between Advanced panel and footer reduced to match top spacing
Advanced panel redesigned — sectioned layout with General, Settings, Plugins, System labels and uniform button rows
Security hardening — URL scheme validation on all API endpoints, IPC input allowlists, concurrent_fragments clamped, video_height allowlisted, open-folder path safety
App size reduction — Python bundle stripped of pip, setuptools, idlelib, tkinter, pycache (~40MB saved on Linux/Mac)
14 new themes: Music (Vinyl, Lo-Fi, Jazz Club, Studio Midnight, Rave, Acoustic), Nature (Bioluminescent, Aurora, Desert Dusk, Volcanic), Cities (Tokyo Neon, Havana, Dubai Midnight, Favela Sunset)
Music, Cities, Moods category tabs added to themes window; total theme count reaches 100
